_comment: Natural black walnut: unfinished (sanded, no oil or lacquer), flat-sawn chocolate-brown heartwood with darker latewood bands and fine open pores. Opaque: a solid, diffuse-dominant dielectric. Base textures are generated (L2, tools/converters/base/gen_blackwalnut_natural.py), not scanned: ambientCG has no asset that says walnut, and the library names only what a source states. Carries every relevant wear layer at 0 (C1): scuffs (overlay 1, damage), scratches, and dust as a deposit (Phase10), gated by the Grime mask. Built by the Phase11 batch.
name: BlackWalnut_Natural_Clean_Base_s01_v01

sources.why: Mean linear albedo (0.16, 0.085, 0.05), about sRGB 112, 82, 63, for unfinished black walnut heartwood; roughness about 0.67 for sanded bare wood; specular_ior 1.5, a generic dielectric. Physically Based has no wood entry.
